description: Get the PREMIUM behavioral trust verdict for an MCP server, with a signed, citable, tamper-evident attestation receipt. This is a paid x402 service: call WITHOUT payment_tx to receive payment instructions (0.001 USDC on Base), pay, then call again WITH the payment_tx (transaction hash, single-use) to receive the full verdict + receipt. The free check_trust tool remains available for basic scores.

payment_tx.description: Base transaction hash proving 0.001 USDC was sent to the pay_to wallet (omit on the first call to get payment instructions)

server_slug.description: The MCP server slug/name to get a paid verdict for
